Pulse 0.11.8

What's improved:
- Improved the legibility of the menu-bar panel on visually busy desktops. Data-dense content now uses a stronger standard macOS material background, while menus and controls retain their native Liquid Glass appearance.

No setup or account changes are required after updating.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.11.8.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
